name: xero-bank-transactions-to-zapier-table

trigger.authentication_note: Xero work.flowers. The Xero credential lives HERE only — the workflow body never calls Xero, it only writes the Zapier Table.
trigger.trigger_note: Polling trigger (New Bank Transaction), one run per transaction. Fires on transaction CREATION, not reconciliation — despite the classic Zap's title 'Process New Reconciled Transactions'. Proof: 26 of 93 rows sampled have a Reference in Xero but '' in the Table, because Xero fills Reference in at reconciliation, after this trigger has already fired. The classic Zap also carried polling_interval_override: 5, which the durable --trigger payload has no field for; the default interval applies.

connections_note: None. The workflow uses no connection aliases — Zapier Tables need no connection, and the Xero credential is on the trigger. --connections was omitted at publish.

connectionless_apps.ZapierTables: read/write via sdk.listTableRecords / createTableRecords / updateTableRecords / deleteTableRecords — no connection, no task cost

version_pinning_note: @zapier/zapier-durable 0.11.0 was npm-latest at build time but only ~20h old; the runtime rejects dependencies younger than 24h at RUN time, not publish. Pinned to 0.10.1.

bank_transactions.name: Xero Bank Transactions
bank_transactions.role: Owned and written by this workflow.

fields.type: Type (labeled_string — a plain string is normalised to {value,label})
fields.currency_rate: CurrencyRate — NEW: the classic Zap never mapped f9, so this column was null on all 651 rows despite being populated on ~36% of transactions

bank_transactions.downstream: drive-invoice-to-xero reads this Table to decide whether an invoice has already been paid. A pause here is a silent production fault there — it produces duplicate draft bills with no error. Treat this workflow as load-bearing.

date_coercion_note: The `date` column is written as YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z. A bare YYYY-MM-DD is interpreted in the account's local timezone (Asia/Singapore) and lands 8 hours off, which shifts every date-window query run against this Table by a day at the boundaries.
description: New Xero bank transaction -> find-or-create its row in the 'Xero Bank Transactions' Zapier Table, keyed on bank_transaction_id. Migration of the classic Zap 'Process New Reconciled Transactions', which created unconditionally. Adds: find-or-create, race-safe dedupe of concurrent creates (converge on the earliest ULID), refresh of an existing row when a mirrored field has actually changed, and the previously-unmapped currency_rate column.

replaces_classic_zap.title: Process New Reconciled Transactions
replaces_classic_zap.old_shape: XeroCLIAPI@2.20.5 bank_transaction trigger -> TableCLIAPI@1.25.0 create_record (unconditional), mapping f1-f8, f10, f11
known_issues_fixed: Created unconditionally, so a re-delivery duplicated the row — the Table holds 4 duplicate pairs across 651 distinct transactions.
No way to correct a row after Xero restated the transaction or an invoice was attached to it.
replaces_classic_zap.status: Its create step was PAUSED, which is why the Table fell ~5 days behind and drive-invoice-to-xero began raising duplicate draft bills. Turn the classic Zap off entirely — do not simply unpause it, or both it and this workflow will write the same rows.

known_gaps.no_backfill_by_design: Enabling this workflow does NOT recover the gap the pause created — a Zapier polling trigger primes its dedupe on first poll, so only transactions created from now on are delivered. The ~7 SPEND transactions missing from 2026-07-21..2026-07-26 (including Anthropic 2026-07-25 SGD 104.58) stay missing, and that is accepted: they were reconciled against their receipts in Xero by hand, and their invoices have already passed through the Drive Invoices folder, which that trigger will not re-deliver. No backfill is planned.
known_gaps.stale_columns: Existing rows carry stale values Xero fills in after the trigger fires: sampled over 93 transactions, 32 had a stale currency_rate, 26 a stale reference, 14 a stale has_attachments, 1 a renamed contact. The update path only corrects a row when the trigger re-delivers that transaction, which for a polling trigger is rare, so these persist. Accepted — no consumer reads those columns today (drive-invoice-to-xero matches on contact_name, type, currency_code, total and date, none of which drift).
known_gaps.next_incident: The mechanic worth remembering: a pause here is silent, and re-enabling restores the flow but never the gap. If a future gap does need recovering, scripts/backfill-zapier-partner-leads.mjs is the house pattern (plan-only unless --commit).
